name: Daxos's Torment — 'this enchantment' becomes a 5/5 Demon creature
notes: Memory: project_three_bug_fixes_2026-04-23. 'This enchantment becomes a 5/5 Demon creature with flying and haste in addition to its other types' was not recognised as a self-reference. With the constellation trigger fired, Daxos's Torment is a 5/5 Demon enchantment creature with flying and haste.

call: this enchantment becomes a 5/5 Demon creature with flying and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.

Constellation — Whenever this enchantment or another enchantment you control enters, this enchantment becomes a 5/5 Demon creature with flying and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
